growth_signal.value: Joined the Techstars Founder Catalyst Programme, an accelerator for founders.

entry.idea: Freelancers and remote workers in emerging markets struggle to get paid quickly across borders and to prove their income, so Bloccpay built a stablecoin-powered platform that runs payroll for distributed teams and lets freelancers invoice and get paid globally.
entry.lesson: Turn a payment feature into a record-keeping tool, so customers build a financial history that can unlock other services later.
entry.name: Bloccpay

growth.basis: substitute: accepted into the Techstars Founder Catalyst accelerator programme
growth.reason: No user or revenue numbers are public; being accepted into the Techstars accelerator is a mild positive signal but not proof of fast growth.

market.reason: Payroll and invoicing for freelancers and remote workers is a need across a huge, global profession, though today the product is focused on emerging-market talent.

tech.reason: Stablecoin-based cross-border payroll and invoicing is solid engineering, but other crypto payroll platforms already do similar things and a strong team could match it in months.

entry.twist: Every payment on the platform builds a documented history of work and income, the kind of proof-of-income record freelancers can later use to open a bank account, get a loan, or apply for a visa.
entry.who_pays: Businesses pay to run payroll for their distributed teams, and freelancers use the invoicing side to collect payments from clients.
entry.why_now: Stablecoins now make it cheap and fast to move money across borders, right as remote work and freelancing for people in emerging markets keeps growing.
